text: #708, step 10 of #564's plan and its last, recorded at #722's merge. Refines D-0121 and keeps D-0301, D-0314, D-0361, D-0372 and D-0379. A configured repository's plumbing agents get its own context from the caller's captured base: planning and revisions, plans of issues, the initial build, a fallback, both repairs and every read-only review. The context names the declared current-state documents, the root and nested agent rules with their captured contents and readable copies, each part's directory, language, image, dependency inputs and lockfiles, shared ownership, every command's argv or inapplicable reason, native acceptance identities, captured regression conventions and the paths a person must merge. Prompts carry at most 16 KiB of it and point to a workspace document with the rest, staged afresh from the capture before every agent run, so a candidate's edits to rules or earlier copies never replace the guidance. Guidance can't expand the ratified plan, acceptance or regression boundaries. Another repository gets only its declared documentation policy: a SPEC.md, README or decision journal doesn't import Invariant's rules, the 400-line README limit or real-suite duties. Invariant's own prompts and checks are unchanged. Configured proposals and pull requests show the regression allowance, literal native identities, the execution line and the configured check results, inapplicable phases included, from the retained summary even after recovery. External plumbing intake stays disabled, and its refusal now names the remaining prerequisites: configuration drafting and generated CI that runs the configured checks and verifies ratification and scope. The real-image budget check wasn't needed, since the context is read from git objects on the host and Invariant's built-in path gets none.
